n9dc935e99f.headline: Study: Half as Many Companies Went Bankrupt During Quarantine Compared to a Year Ago
n9dc935e99f.summary: During the quarantine from March 1 to July 1, 250 companies went bankrupt in Lithuania, nearly half fewer than the same period last year.
n9dc935e99f.why: This decline in bankruptcies may reflect government support measures or altered economic activity during the pandemic, impacting Lithuania's business environment.
